items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...worked with Teddy Bunn... [INTERVIEWEE] Teddy Bunn no.

ctx.x: And a sweet guy. Oh we loved him so much. Just like our own.
Well now, after T-Bone, it says you do Orson Welles radio show, worked with Teddy Bunn
and then Slim Galliard in the Spring of '45.
